triage.rationale: Single vehicle, no other party, nobody hurt, car drivable, photos and a complete quote (NZD 1,040.75 including GST), policy on file, every required question answerable. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 January 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2021-03-14, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
